top_signals.title: By The Way: Headlines You May Have Missed
top_signals.summary: The sneaker bubble bursting, hardware store cats, learning to write cursive, and live book readings: Join Lisa Mateo, David Gura and Christina Ruffini for a roundup of headlines you may have missed, but gotta see. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
